value.thought: The student wants to know why Docker is important for their ML engineer career. I will explain the relevance of Docker based on job ads and its role in ML engineering, using simple language since the student is new to university.
value.answer: Docker is important because 41% of machine learning engineer job ads ask for it, and this number is rising. It helps you package your code and its environment into containers, so your projects run the same way everywhere. This is very useful in ML engineering where you often share models and code with others or deploy them to servers. Learning Docker now will make you more job-ready and confident.
